svg.desc: Architecture diagram of /alon-skills:build-loop: 11 stages (plan, scout, spec, research, build, measure, refute with 6 lenses, merge, arbiter, fix, close) running as fresh subagents across Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, reading and writing state in the repo (TODO_WORKFLOW.md, SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md, spec.md, docs/handoff.md).
